about_short_description.short_description: Candor helps employees and executives trade RSUs compliantly

product.name: RSU Trading Plan and Automation
product.description: A platform that helps employees and executives manage and trade Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) automatically, including outside issuer-imposed trading windows, with tax optimization and diversification features.

product.name: 10b5-1 Plan Automation for Issuers
product.description: A scalable platform for public companies to automate 10b5-1 trading plans for executives and employees, ensuring compliance with SEC and issuer policies and reducing trading desk risk.

product.name: Capital Markets and Governance Suites
product.description: Tools for public companies to monitor and control employee stock trading activities, insider share activity, and market impact of stock-based compensation.

identifier.value: Employee Financial Planning and Education Services

product.name: Employee Financial Planning and Education Services
product.description: A service providing employees with financial planning, tax support, education, and tax optimization tools related to equity compensation.

identifier.value: RSU Compensation Data and Salary Database

product.name: RSU Compensation Data and Salary Database
product.description: A database and tool providing salary and equity compensation data from major tech companies to help users benchmark and analyze their compensation packages.
